Medicine Dosage Calculator

Compute a weight-based single dose and daily total from mg/kg — always verify with a pharmacist or doctor.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This tool does arithmetic only. Always verify any dose with a pharmacist or doctor before giving medicine. Wrong doses can be dangerous. This is not medical advice.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Verify every result with a pharmacist or doctor before use.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter body weight in kilograms.
  2. Enter the prescribed dose in mg per kg.
  3. Enter doses per day.
  4. Read the single dose and daily total — then VERIFY with a pharmacist or doctor.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the dose calculated?

Weight in kg × prescribed mg per kg. Dosing must come from a clinician or the medicine label — never invent it.

What is the daily total?

Daily total = single dose × doses per day. It helps you check the label math, not replace it.

Can I trust this result?

This tool does arithmetic only. Wrong inputs or wrong mg/kg values can be dangerous — always verify with a pharmacist or doctor.
